title: Mandarin numbers
examples: How do I say the number fifteen in Mandarin?
What is the pattern for counting past ten?
Can you teach me how to count to twenty?

explain.say: Today we will learn some basic Mandarin numbers.
The number one is said as yī. Can you repeat yī for me?
The number two is said as èr. Try saying èr out loud for your teacher.
The number three is said as sān. Remember to keep a clear sound when you say sān.
When we count higher, we use 'shí' for ten. For example, twelve is shí èr.
For a real-life example, if you have fifteen apples, you say shí wǔ apples.

faq.q: How do I say the number fifteen in Mandarin?
faq.a: You say shí wǔ. It means ten and five together.
asks: Can you teach me the number fifteen?

faq.q: What is the word for ten?
faq.a: The word for ten is shí. It is used to count numbers ten or more.
asks: What is the base word for tens?

faq.q: Is the order always the same when counting?
faq.a: Yes, the order is always the same from one up to one hundred.
asks: Do I change the order when counting?
What is the rule for counting?

faq.a: You say èr shí. You say two and then ten.
asks: What is the Mandarin for twenty?

faq.q: Do I use 'shí' every time I pass ten?
faq.a: Yes, you use shí when you count the tens place number.

quiz.say: How do you say the number twelve in Mandarin?
quiz.why: The number twelve is ten and two, so it is shí èr.

wrong.0: This means two ten, which is incorrect for twelve.
wrong.1: This means ten and three, which is the number thirteen.
wrong.2: This means three ten, which is the number thirty.

quiz.say: What is the correct way to say the number twenty-one?
quiz.why: Twenty-one is two tens and one, so it is èr shí yī.

wrong.0: This is just two and one, not including the tens place.
wrong.1: This mixes up the order of the numbers.
wrong.3: This only means eleven, not twenty-one.

quiz.say: If you count to fifty, which word do you use for the 'fifty' part?
quiz.why: To make fifty, you say five and then shí, which is wǔ shí.

wrong.0: This only means the number five by itself.
wrong.1: This means ten and five, which is fifteen.
wrong.2: This would mean fifty and five, which is too many numbers.
